quote: We spend our entire lives collecting shadows, believing we are holding onto solid things. You build fences around a wind that refuses to stay. You give your years to ghosts that vanish by morning. Then the silence arrives to show you the empty hands. Nothing was ever yours to keep in the dark.
caption:
We spend our entire lives collecting shadows, believing we are holding onto solid things. You build fences around a wind that refuses to stay. You give your years to ghosts that vanish by morning. Then the silence arrives to show you the empty hands. Nothing was ever yours to keep in the dark.
